values.note: State forest campsite $17 a night, taxes included, paid online (Yodel) on the day of arrival or at a state park ranger station; no paying ahead and no on-site payment.

fees.source: DNR state forest fees page ('Individual and equestrian campsites $17 - $22'; 'Fees include taxes.'; 'Same day advance payment is available on your arrival date, you may not pay ahead'; 'DNR does not accept self-payment envelopes on site'), read 2026-11-11

hookups.source: DNR campground sheet cmp00032 ('61 campsites (non-electrical)'), read 2026-11-11

values.note: 61 drive-in sites, two accessible; the DNR says most can take large RVs.

sites.source: DNR campground sheet cmp00032 ('61 drive-in campsites (2 handicapped accessible sites)'; 'most can accommodate large RV's') + DNR facility record ('Each of the 61 campsites'), read 2026-11-11

facilities.source: DNR campground sheet ('6 vault-type toilets'; 'Drinking water is piped to several locations throughout the camping area') + facility record ('seasonal drinking water'), read 2026-11-11

values.note: Closed November 22, 2026 to May 7, 2027, depending on weather; water off and no trash service from November 1.

season.source: DNR facility record cmp00032 ('Campground closed November 22 - May 7, 2027, depending upon weather conditions. Water is off for the season. No trash service November 1 - mid-May.'), read 2026-11-11

booking.source: DNR state forest fees page ('Upon arrival at the campground, choose an unoccupied campsite'; only group campsites are reservable, and Woodenfrog is not on the group-site list), read 2026-11-11

note: State forest campground on a pine-covered point on Lake Kabetogama, beside Voyageurs National Park and its Kabetogama Lake Visitor Center. Sand swimming beach, boat ramp and docks, a picnic area, a nature trail and a CCC-era refectory used for park ranger programs. Managed from Bear Head Lake State Park. --Claude
summary: DNR forest record + campground sheet + fees page read: 61 non-electric drive-in sites (most take large RVs), vault toilets, piped seasonal water, $17 incl. tax paid online same day, first come; closed Nov 22 - May 7 (2027). Not waterfront kept. Pin is on the private resort next to the day-use area, ~380 m east -> move. Phone 218-235-2520 confirmed.
flags: Pin 48.4818,-93.0588 is on the private resort beside the boat ramp (the DNR map labels it 'Private Resort'), ~380 m east of the campground. Move to the DNR facility point 48.481835,-93.063963, inside the campground loops.

Waterfront: keep not waterfront. The DNR map puts sites 1-3 and 33-38 nearest the lake, but imagery shows them ~60-75 m from Kabetogama through continuous forest (sites 1-3 at ~48.4824,-93.0620; the western loop's north end ~48.4826,-93.0650 behind a wooded band above the sand shore); no open ground to the water.
Phone 218-235-2520 confirmed (DNR facility manager: Bear Head Lake State Park).
Website keeps the forest page; the forest page URL now redirects to https://www.dnr.state.mn.us/state-forests/forest.html?id=sft00027 (old one still works).
Note: stored 'tents and small/medium RVs' contradicts the DNR sheet ('most can accommodate large RV's'); rewritten.
